exactPrompt:
Create ONE ORIGINAL pixel-art inventory atlas with exactly TWO separate salvaged agricultural-machine items for ASHVEIL, a grounded melancholy dark-fantasy survival game in an ash-covered post-apocalyptic forest. Two columns by ONE row; LEFT is a small sealed low-light SEED CAPSULE, RIGHT is a much larger EMPTY INDUSTRIAL STORAGE TANK. Original artwork only, no copied or traced commercial-game assets. No characters or full machines.

The established ORIGINAL ASHVEIL Sower has pale desaturated grey-olive/ivory METAL tanks with domed tops, black short fill necks, dark gunmetal retaining bands, small dull bronze connectors, subtle vertical wear and ash stains. Its smaller top tank is a squat rounded cylinder; the other taller hopper is ribbed. Use that same industrial family, material language and modest top/front three-quarter camera. Detailed deliberate crisp pixel clusters, strong nearly-black broken edges, broad muted material planes, restrained warm-grey upper-left highlights. Readable and distinguishable at32px, no smooth3D rendering, cartoon stickers, fantasy ornaments, electric glow or oversized glossy glints. Keep the quieter warm worn-material shading consistent with handmade ash-stained field tools and old parchment notes.

LEFT CELL: ONE complete SMALL SEALED LOW-LIGHT SEED CAPSULE, a compact oblong cylindrical seed cartridge with softly rounded ends, dark gunmetal closure rims at top/bottom and a desaturated olive-tan protective sleeve. Narrow silhouette about half as wide as tall, slightly diagonal or upright. A small dull AMBER inspection strip in the central sleeve shows a few solid dark brown oval seeds packed inside, no luminous liquid, no fumes and no protruding plant. Its botanical seed contents are the defining cue. A plain short closed black end cap and subtle retaining ridge fit a mechanical planting-feed opening. No protruding wires, electrical terminals, trigger, pin, fins, pointed bullet tip, weapon parts, hazard labels, medicine syringe or ornate potion bottle. One attached closed object, no loose seeds or extra cap. It is a small plantable seed container, not a battery, grenade, ammunition shell or large tank.

RIGHT CELL: ONE complete LARGE EMPTY SOWER STORAGE TANK, the salvaged SHORT ROUND pale metal tank from the Sower's back: a broad squat cylindrical vessel with domed shoulders, a short BLACK FILL NECK at top, two dark gunmetal retaining bands around upper/lower rims, restrained rivets, a tiny dull bronze lower hose-connection stub and a few vertical dirt streaks. Light desaturated grey-olive/ivory metal with worn edges, matte and heavy, not translucent glass. The top fill neck is visibly OPEN as a small dark recessed hollow oval, with dry dark interior and no visible contents. This shows the recovered tank is empty without any cutaway diagram. No liquid surface, fill color, seed pile, fungus, leaking fluid, glowing core, pressure flame, giant nozzle, gun barrel, legs, hoses sprawling outside the icon or detached lid. The tank must remain an intact usable hollow vessel rather than broken scrap. Not a jerrycan, fuel barrel, battery pack, kettle or modern plastic jug. Broad compact silhouette, about as wide as tall; recognizably larger/bulkier construction than the thin seed capsule.

Each complete object is centered in its own equal roomy cell with large TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA alpha0 margins and a wide transparent gutter. Nothing touches any cell edge or neighboring icon. Keep the small capsule to roughly45 percent of cell height and the large tank to roughly65 percent, while retaining readable detail. Do not place any other object in either cell. No grid, lettering, readable writing, symbols, numeric capacity marks, labels, UI panel, floor, cast shadow outside the objects, background, halo, vignette, frame, scene, hand, animal or person. Exactly one transparent PNG containing exactly these two separate original icons.
